task.title: ; from ORBIT with no ported target wipes your trims
task.body:
## What the player sees
Press `;` in ORBIT with no ported target: the view skips PORT (correctly) and lands on SURF, but your pitch/heading trims are zeroed as if you had entered PORT.

## Why
`internal/sim/nav.go:146-156` + `:196-213`: `CycleNavMode` calls `setNavMode` on every rejected candidate, so the PORT entry zeroing runs on a mode never shown (PR #680's one-pair rule).

## Evidence
Batch review 2 finding F1 (should fix), CONFIRMED (trims 0.1/-0.2 -> 0/0). vault `reviews/2026-10-17-batch-review-2-adr0055-0057-fixes.md`.

## Done when
Only the mode actually landed on applies its enter/leave rules; guard covers a cycle that skips PORT.
